name: What materials are commonly used for interior trim and moldings?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for interior trim and moldings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for interior trim and moldings include solid wood (like pine, oak, or maple), MDF (medium-density fiberboard), and PVC. Solid wood offers natural beauty and durability, suitable for staining or painting, but can be more expensive. MDF is a cost-effective option, ideal for painting, and resistant to warping, while PVC is excellent for moisture-prone areas like bathrooms due to its water resistance. Your choice depends on your budget, desired finish (painted vs. stained), and the specific environmental conditions of the room.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior trim materials include solid wood for natural beauty, MDF for cost-effectiveness and painting, and PVC for moisture resistance.
